preconditions: The actual work product is an LLM prompt, agent instruction, tool description, or model input template; an incidental word match or ordinary reasoning is insufficient.
Applicable instructions, existing authorization, target scope and material evidence are preserved. This optional specialist does not rewrite every incoming request or choose the final skill set.
Direct use does not require a new workflow. In a formal workflow, provide the external prompt-engineering-request and preserve the existing task, mutation, acceptance and audit obligations.
providers.failureHandling: Return NEEDS_INPUT only for material missing evidence while preserving completed work. ANALYZED means the requested design or review is complete, not proven model improvement or acceptance. NOT_RUN never means evaluated. Run the bundled checker explicitly when binding evidence is needed; its checks do not establish semantic truth or approval.
